worker_claim.report: The available execution budget was consumed implementing and exercising the requested positive interrupted-generation recovery milestone; the canonical ticket is still incomplete. Supported consumers now include recovery_workspace_manager, _execution_workspace_for_recovery, and _normalize_stranded_execution through _reconcile_stranded_execution. Real-Git tests restart from persisted isolated worker-running and post-worker state, normalize the same execution ID/branch/path, preserve the original dirty unowned workspace, and survive interruptions immediately before and after the idle journal write. Admission began with no failed_executions[T-1] record; normalization records a real interruption of the new generation, not a fabricated historical record. The full TASK-134-shaped ordinary isolated scheduler assertion remains strict XFAIL. Focused failed-rework tests: 27 passed, 1 xfailed; recovery-boundary tests: 15 passed; Ruff and git diff --check passed. Two completed full coverage runs each had 1691 passed, 2 skipped, 1 xfailed and two timing-sensitive failures in different IPC/daemon tests; those failing tests passed individually. The subsequent full non-coverage run exceeded its timeout near completion. No Git lifecycle operations or real ticket resources were modified.
